title: What is a tarot spread?
description: A tarot spread is a layout where each card position has its own meaning. Learn how spreads work and how they differ from a single draw.

scenes.headline: What is a tarot spread?
scenes.caption: A tarot spread is a set of cards laid out in a pattern, where each position in the pattern asks its own question.
scenes.vo: A tarot spread is a set of cards laid out in a pattern, where each position in the pattern asks its own question.

scenes.headline: Cards, positions and a question
scenes.caption: A tarot spread has three parts. There are the cards themselves, which come from a 78-card deck.
scenes.vo: Cards, positions and a question. A tarot spread has three parts. There are the cards themselves, which come from a 78-card deck.

scenes.headline: How a spread differs from a single draw
scenes.caption: Drawing one card is the simplest way to use tarot. You ask a question, turn over a card and think about what it suggests.
scenes.vo: How a spread differs from a single draw. Drawing one card is the simplest way to use tarot. You ask a question, turn over a card and think about what it suggests.

scenes.headline: Have a tarot spread in front of you?
scenes.caption: Photograph it and get a clear reading, card by card.
